findings.claim: Biology remains unmapped despite mapped Genetics, Evolutionary Biology and Physiology interfaces; Human bounded biological research cannot be lifted into Biology parent coverage.

Philosophy remains unmapped despite Metaphysics, Philosophy of Science and Ethics/Value Theory mappings across autonomous owners; cross-owner child aggregation cannot manufacture Philosophy authority.

Psychology and Computation provide positive controls: their parent-level direct partial mappings are grounded in explicit owner-native basisResultRefs and bounded parent semantic scope, not child-count thresholds.
Because Reference child sets are open-world, overlapping and non-exhaustive, no numeric fraction of mapped children can serve as a valid generic parent-lift threshold.

Parent non-lifting should become a durable crosswalk lint for future mapping admission: direct owner-native source scope is required; graph/decomposition evidence may support search but cannot create authority.
